gīta.p: [Ge+ta] (na) CL=8 (1) Singing; Singing , chanting .(2) Song, music.   (Ti) (3) to be chanted.

C: gīta：[nt.] a song； singing．（pp．of gāyati），sung； recited.
P:
Gīta，[pp．of gāyati] 1．（pp.） sung，recited，solemnly proclaimed，enunciated：mantapadaṁ gītaṁ pavuttaṁ D.I，104 （cp．gira）．-- 2．（nt.） singing，a song； grouped under vācasikā khiḍḍā，musical pastimes at Nd2 219； SnA 86．Usually combd with nacca，dancing：A.I，261； Vv8110 as naca gītādi J.I，61； VvA.131； referring to nacca-gīta-vādita，dancing with singing & instrumental accompaniment D.III，183 （under samajja，kinds of festivities）； Vv 324．Same with visūkadassana，pantomimic show at D.I，5≈（cp．DA.I，77； KhA 36）.

--rava sound of song Mhvs VII.30； --sadda id．J.IV，3； Dhs.621； DhA.I，15； --ssara id．Vin.II，108； A.III，251； J.III，188．（Page 251）
R:
gīta：ဂီတ （န）
သီဆိုခြင်း။ သီချင်း။
ဂီတံ ဂါယိတွာ၊ သီချင်းဆို၍။ ဂီတဝသေန၊ သီချင်း၏အစွမ်းဖြင့်။

DOP: gāyati ( and gāti 2 ?), pr. 3 sg. [ S. gāyati, occasionally gāti], sings; recites in a singing manner ; Dhātup 393 (gā sadde); Dhātum 627; Vin I 346, 10 (tvaṃ bhaṇe māṇavaka ~assu vīṇaṃ ca vādehī ti); II 108, 6 foll. ( a ) gāya(t), mfn. , Vism 689, 19 (madhurena sarena ~ato mātugāmassa); ( b ) gāyanta, mf (~antī) n. , Vin II 108, 16 (dhammaṃ ~antassa); A IV 55, 12 (mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti … bhaṇantiyā vā ~antiyā vā vādantiyā vā); Ja III 447, 7 (gītaṃ ~anto); Spk III 103, 12 (naccantā viya ~antā viya ca naṭavesaṃ gahetvā paccanti); ( c ) gāyamāna, mfn. , Vin I 38, 13 (imā gāthāyo ~amāno, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr gīyamāno); Ja IV 470, 17* ; Vism 120, 5 (sākahārikā ~amānā paṇṇaṃ uccinantiyo); Spk I 30, 22 ; — gāyamāno in Ce, Ee at Pv-a 151, 17 is prob. wr; Be, Se vāyamamāno; — aor. 3 sg. gāyi, Vin I 345, 35 ; A IV 263, 18 (ekā va ~i ekā va nacci ekā va accharikaṃ vādesi); Ja III 409, 30 (bodhisatto … imāhi dvīhi gāthāhi udānagītaṃ ~i); Vism 121, 23 (ekā yakkhinī … ~i); 3 pl. gāyiṃsu, Ja VI 410, 27 ; Sp 1202, 8 (amhākaṃ ācariyā pi upajjhāyā pi evaṃ ~iṃsū ti); Dāṭh 5:31; 1 pl. agāyimha, gāyimha, Ja I 362, 18* (apāyimha anaccimha agāyimha rudimha ca; 362, 21´ : mukhaṃ vivaritvā āyatakena sarena ~imha); — inf. gāyituṃ, Ja II 329, 12 ; Spk III 295, 16 (sā pi pāsādikā naccituṃ ~ituṃ chekā); — absol. gāyitvā, Vv 32:2; Ja III 507, 12 (naccitvā ~itvā); IV 470, 13 (sā … agganakhehi vīṇaṃ vādentī madhurena sarena ~itvā taṃ palobhesi); Sadd 467, 6 ; — neg. agāyitvā, Ja V 249, 21 ; — pass. ( a ) pr. 3 sg. gīyati , Nidd I 420, 15 (anugīyantī ti ~anti niggīyanti kathīyanti, Be so; Ce ~antī ti; Ee, Se ~antī ti ~anti kathiyanti); Th-a I 8, 6 (~atī ti gāthā); — part.pr. gīyamāna, mfn. , Ja VI 60, 22* (~amānesu gītesu); — gīyamāno in Ee at Vin I 38, 13 is wr for gāyamāno ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — pass. ( b ) aor. 3 sg. agāyittha ( or act. ?) Sadd 850, 4 (gāyanaṃ agāyitthā ti vā gītaṃ naccanaṃ anaccitthā ti vā naccam); — pp ( a ) gīta , mfn. and n. ( and ~ā, f. ?) [ ts ], 1. ( mfn. ) sung, chanted ; Vin I 245, 18 (idaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ ~aṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tad anugāyanti) = D I 104, 11 (Sv 273, 17 foll. : sarasampattivasena sājjhāyitaṃ); Ja III 61, 25 (tumhehi imasmiṃ gītake ~e); — 2. ( n.f. ) singing; a song ; Abh 130 (~aṃ gānaṃ); Vin I 268, 12 (gaṇikā … padakkhiṇā nacce ca ~e ca vādite ca); 345, 37 (assosi … mañjunā sarena ~aṃ vīṇaṃ ca vāditaṃ); IV 267, 29 foll. (yā … bhikkhunī naccaṃ vā ~aṃ vā vāditaṃ vā dassanāya gaccheyya pācittiyaṃ … ~aṃ nāma yaṃ kiñci ~aṃ; Sp 925, 12 foll. : yaṃ kiñci naṭādīnaṃ vā ~aṃ hotu ariyānaṃ parinibbānakāle ratanattaya-guṇūpasaṃhitaṃ sādhukīḷitagītaṃ vā asaṃyata-bhikkhūnaṃ dhammabhāṇakagītaṃ vā sabbaṃ p’ etaṃ ~am eva); D II 159, 21 (bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi ~ehi vāditehi … sakkarontā); Ja III 223, 4* (na-y-idha naccaṃ vā ~aṃ vā tālaṃ vā susamāhitaṃ); V 330, 7* (thanakhīrena ~ena … rodantaṃ puttaṃ toseti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr gitena); VI 410, 25 (atimanoharāni ~āni bandhitvā); Ps II 209, 3 (attanā naccananaccāpanādi-vasena naccā ca ~ā ca vāditā ca); — ifc see jūta-, nacca-; — see also paṭigīta ( sv paṭigāti ); — ~-ssara, m. [gīta + sara 5 ], the sound or tone of singing; a singing accent or tone ; Vin II 108, 6 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū āyatakena ~-ssarena dhammaṃ gāyanti); D II 267, 16 (saṃsandati … tantissaro ~-ssarena ~-ssaro ca tantissarena); Ja III 188, 23 (tantissarena ~-ssaraṃ anatikkamanto gandhabbaṃ akāsi); — duggīta, mfn. , sung badly or incorrectly ; D I 99, 11 (esā … brahmunā Sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā na duggītā); — sugīta, mfn. , sung well or correctly ; D I 99, 11 ; Th 51 (vassati devo yathā sugītaṃ; Th-a I 134, 21 : sundaraṃ gītaṃ viya gajjanto); Ja IV 394, 30* (gāthā sugītā); V 506, 11* (bahuṃ sugītaṃ ca suvāditaṃ ca); — pp ( b ) gāyita, mfn. , Ja IV 393, 22 (dvīsu gītesu gāyitesu); Dhp-a III 233, 17 (tayā imasmiṃ gīte gāyite); — fpp ( a ) geyya , ( mf ) n. [ cf S. geya], the name of one of the nine categories ( aṅga s) of the scriptures ; Vin III 8, 7 (appakaṃ ca nesaṃ ahosi suttaṃ ~aṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ); M III 115, 18 (na kho … arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ yadidaṃ suttaṃ ~aṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ tassa hetu, Be, Ce so; Ee veyyākaraṇassa hetu, prob. wr; Se suttageyyaveyyākaraṇassa sotuṃ); A IV 113, 15 (bhikkhu dhammaṃ jānāti suttaṃ ~aṃ … vedallaṃ; Mp III 5, 22 : sabbaṃ pi sagāthakaṃ suttaṃ ~an ti veditabbaṃ, visesena saṃyuttake sakalo pi sagāthaka-vaggo); Nidd I 143, 29 (suttaṃ ~aṃ … vedallaṃ, idaṃ pariyattisāsanaṃ); Peṭ 5, 15 ; Mil 263, 2 ; Sp 28, 5 (kathaṃ [buddhavacanaṃ] aṅgavasena navavidhaṃ, sabbam eva h’ idaṃ suttaṃ ~aṃ … vedallan ti navappabhedaṃ hoti); Sadd 610, 10* (sagāthattā taṃ ~an ti pavuccati); — fpp ( b ) gāyitabba, mfn. , Vin II 108, 22 (na bhikkhave āyatakena gītassarena dhammo ~o); — caus. ( a ) pr. 3 sg. gāyāpeti , Spk III 120, 24 (manussā nāma vaṇṇabhāṇakānaṃ dhanaṃ datvā attano dārikānaṃ vaṇṇagītaṃ ~enti, Be, Se so; Ce vaṇṇabhaṇanaṭṭhānaṃ patvā attano dāyakānaṃ vaṇṇagītaṃ ~enti; Ee vaṇṇa-bhāṇakaṭṭhānaṃ patvā attano vādakānaṃ vaṇṇagītaṃ ~enti); — part.pr. gāyāpenta, mfn. , Sp 1201, 26 (sayaṃ gāyantassāpi ~entassāpi dukkaṭam eva); — aor. 3 sg. gāyāpesi, Dhp-a III 231, 14 (dhītaraṃ … naccāpetvā ~esi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee naccetvā ~eti); — absol. gāyāpetvā, Ja VI 410, 15 (tāni kabbāni Mithilāyaṃ ~etvā); — caus. ( b ) aor. 3 sg. gāpayī, Ap 546, 22 (gāyake gāpayī, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pāpayī, prob. wr ); — see also paṭigāti.
NCP: pp mfn & n. | giita , (n.f) sung; recited; chanted. singing a song.
